title: PASTA: A Scalable Framework for Multi-Policy AI Compliance Evaluation
reasoning: The paper presents a framework for evaluating AI system compliance with regulatory policies. While the system evaluates 'Ethical Considerations' as a category of documentation (such as risk mitigation and potential harms), this is treated as a component of regulatory compliance rather than a philosophical or theological evaluation of morals, faith, or spiritual traditions. The mention of ethics is primarily as a data category within model cards and policy requirements.
